introduction: Vermont offers Medicaid coverage through Green Mountain Care, including coverage routes for children and adults. Eligibility categories have different application requirements.
description: Vermont offers Medicaid coverage through Green Mountain Care, including coverage routes for children and adults. Eligibility categories have different application requirements.

sections.who: Age, income, status and other circumstances determine the appropriate route. Older applicants, Medicare recipients and people with disabilities may need the aged, blind or disabled process.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps pay for covered health services. Review your program and plan information before arranging care.
sections.docs:
• Household income and identity information.
  • Requested status and current coverage records.
  • Resources and disability-related evidence if required for the category.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the route

    Use DVHA Apply and the Vermont Health Connect links, or call 855-899-9600.

  2. Complete category-specific forms

    Ask whether supplemental aged, blind or disabled materials are needed.

  3. Read the decision

    Check effective dates and follow any plan or provider instructions.
sections.after: Keep contact details current, review renewal mail and return requested information. Ask DVHA about appeal instructions if you disagree.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DVHA coverage application; MABD checklist. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
